question: Should upstream review of this managed-configuration RFC continue now, or should it be withdrawn until the fork design is ready for sponsorship?
rationale: The RFC proposes a new core configuration authority model, while the contributor explicitly said the upstream opening was premature and no maintainer has yet sponsored or reviewed the direction.

options.title: Continue draft review
options.body: Keep the PR open as a draft, correct `rfc_pr`, link the required maintainer-discussion thread, and review the core compatibility contract before acceptance.

options.title: Withdraw until ready
options.body: Close the draft and invite a fresh upstream RFC when the contributor considers the fork design ready for maintainer review.

recommendation.title: Continue draft review
recommendation.body: Keep the PR open as a draft, correct `rfc_pr`, link the required maintainer-discussion thread, and review the core compatibility contract before acceptance.
